--- file:///.src/matchToResultOrOption_effectfulReferences.ts ---
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics matchToResultOrOption:warning
import { Data, Effect, Function, Option, pipe, Result } from "effect"

class UserNotFound extends Data.TaggedError("UserNotFound")<{
  readonly id: string
}> {}

interface User {
  readonly name: string
}

declare const fetchUser: (id: string) => Effect.Effect<User, UserNotFound>
declare const getOption: () => typeof Option
declare const getResult: () => typeof Result
declare const getEffect: () => typeof Effect
declare const getFunction: () => typeof Function
declare const record: (value: unknown) => void

// Every handler below reaches the reifying constructors, but evaluating it runs
// other code too (a call in the constructor's receiver). Effect.result and
// Effect.option would drop that code, so none of them is reported.

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Option.none reached through a call in the failure handler body
export const noneThroughCall = Effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: () => getOption().none(),
  onSuccess: Option.some
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: identity forwarder whose constructor receiver is a call
export const forwarderThroughCall = Effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: (e) => getResult().fail(e),
  onSuccess: Result.succeed
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: point-free constructor whose receiver is a call
export const pointFreeThroughCall = Effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: Result.fail,
  onSuccess: getResult().succeed
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: point-free constructor behind a comma expression
export const pointFreeThroughComma = Effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: (record("failure"), Result).fail,
  onSuccess: Result.succeed
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: matchEffect branch whose Effect.succeed receiver is a call
export const succeedThroughCall = Effect.matchEffect(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: (e) => getEffect().succeed(Result.fail(e)),
  onSuccess: (user) => Effect.succeed(Result.succeed(user))
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: matchEffect branch whose constructor receiver is a call
export const matchEffectConstructorThroughCall = Effect.matchEffect(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: () => Effect.succeed(getOption().none()),
  onSuccess: (user) => Effect.succeed(Option.some(user))
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: map argument whose constructor receiver is a call
export const mapThroughCall = fetchUser("u1").pipe(
  Effect.map(getResult().succeed),
  Effect.catch((e) => Effect.succeed(Result.fail(e)))
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catch handler whose constructor receiver is a call
export const catchThroughCall = fetchUser("u1").pipe(
  Effect.map(Result.succeed),
  Effect.catch((e) => Effect.succeed(getResult().fail(e)))
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: pipe function reached through a call in the handler body
export const pipeThroughCall = Effect.matchEffect(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: (e) => getFunction().pipe(e, Result.fail, Effect.succeed),
  onSuccess: (user) => Effect.succeed(Result.succeed(user))
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a .pipe method call on the handler argument can run arbitrary code
export const pipeableMethodBody = Effect.matchEffect(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: (e) => e.pipe(Result.fail, Effect.succeed),
  onSuccess: (user) => Effect.succeed(Result.succeed(user))
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: only direct calls are recognized in handler bodies, not pipe(...)
export const pipeFunctionBody = Effect.matchEffect(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: (e) => pipe(e, Result.fail, Effect.succeed),
  onSuccess: (user) => Effect.succeed(Result.succeed(user))
})

// MUST TRIGGER: parenthesized side-effect-free constructor references
export const parenthesizedReferences = Effect.result(fetchUser("u1"))

// MUST TRIGGER: parenthesized side-effect-free callee in the failure handler body
export const parenthesizedNone = Effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: () => (Option.none)(),
  onSuccess: Option.some
})

let moduleReads = 0
const modules = {
  get option(): typeof Option {
    moduleReads++
    return Option
  },
  get result(): typeof Result {
    moduleReads++
    return Result
  },
  get effect(): typeof Effect {
    moduleReads++
    return Effect
  }
}
const plainModules = { Option, Result }

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Option.none reached through a getter in the failure handler body
export const noneThroughGetter = Effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: () => modules.option.none(),
  onSuccess: Option.some
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: point-free constructor reached through a getter
export const pointFreeThroughGetter = Effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: modules.result.fail,
  onSuccess: Result.succeed
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: matchEffect branch whose Effect.succeed is reached through a getter
export const succeedThroughGetter = Effect.matchEffect(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: (e) => modules.effect.succeed(Result.fail(e)),
  onSuccess: (user) => Effect.succeed(Result.succeed(user))
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: map argument reached through a getter
export const mapThroughGetter = fetchUser("u1").pipe(
  Effect.map(modules.option.some),
  Effect.catch(() => Effect.succeed(Option.none()))
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: constructor read from a plain object, which is not a module namespace
export const plainObjectReceiver = Effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: (e) => plainModules.Result.fail(e),
  onSuccess: Result.succeed
})

// MUST TRIGGER (no fix): the handlers only reify, but the fix would drop the getter in the callee
export const matchThroughGetter = modules.effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: Result.fail,
  onSuccess: Result.succeed
})

void moduleReads

// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics matchToResultOrOption:warning
import { Data, Effect, Function, Option, pipe, Result } from "effect"

class UserNotFound extends Data.TaggedError("UserNotFound")<{
  readonly id: string
}> {}

interface User {
  readonly name: string
}

declare const fetchUser: (id: string) => Effect.Effect<User, UserNotFound>
declare const getOption: () => typeof Option
declare const getResult: () => typeof Result
declare const getEffect: () => typeof Effect
declare const getFunction: () => typeof Function
declare const record: (value: unknown) => void

// Every handler below reaches the reifying constructors, but evaluating it runs
// other code too (a call in the constructor's receiver). Effect.result and
// Effect.option would drop that code, so none of them is reported.

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Option.none reached through a call in the failure handler body
export const noneThroughCall = Effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: () => getOption().none(),
  onSuccess: Option.some
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: identity forwarder whose constructor receiver is a call
export const forwarderThroughCall = Effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: (e) => getResult().fail(e),
  onSuccess: Result.succeed

  onFailure: Result.fail,
  onSuccess: getResult().succeed

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: point-free constructor behind a comma expression

  onFailure: (record("failure"), Result).fail,
  onSuccess: Result.succeed

export const pipeThroughCall = Effect.matchEffect(fetchUser("u1"), {

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: only direct calls are recognized in handler bodies, not pipe(...)
export const pipeFunctionBody = Effect.matchEffect(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: (e) => pipe(e, Result.fail, Effect.succeed),
  onSuccess: (user) => Effect.succeed(Result.succeed(user))
})

// MUST TRIGGER: parenthesized side-effect-free constructor references
export const parenthesizedReferences = Effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: (Result.fail),
  onSuccess: (Result.succeed)
})

// MUST TRIGGER: parenthesized side-effect-free callee in the failure handler body
export const parenthesizedNone = Effect.option(fetchUser("u1"))

let moduleReads = 0
const modules = {
  get option(): typeof Option {
    moduleReads++
    return Option
  },
  get result(): typeof Result {
    moduleReads++
    return Result
  },
  get effect(): typeof Effect {
    moduleReads++
    return Effect
  }
}
const plainModules = { Option, Result }

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Option.none reached through a getter in the failure handler body

  onFailure: () => modules.option.none(),

})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: point-free constructor reached through a getter
export const pointFreeThroughGetter = Effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
